name: @ent/capacitor
description: ENT Scolaire — application mobile installable (Android/iOS), emballe apps/web via Capacitor

scripts.sync: cd ../web && npm run build && cd ../capacitor && cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.local/jdks/jdk-21.0.12.1+1 ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/.local/android-sdk ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
